question: Which is the official bird of Andaman Nicobar island?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Wood Pegion.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Wood Pigeon**

 
 
• The Wood Pigeon is a large species in the dove and pigeon family.
 
• It is the official bird of** Andaman Nicobar island**
 
• It is native to the western Palearctic.
 
• It belongs to the **genus Columba.**
 
• It has historically been known as the ring dove and is locally known in southeast England as the** "culver".**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sooty Tern**

 
 
• The Sooty Tern is the **state bird of Lakshadweep.**
 
• Locally known as** 'Karifettu'.**
 
• These birds are common in Tropical oceans.
 
• Lakshadweep provides just the ideal condition for the Sooty terns that are very commonly found in the island.
 
 
 
• **Great Hornbill**
 
 
• **​**Great** **Hornbill is the **state bird of** both **Arunachal Pradesh** and **Kerala**.
 
• It is one of the larger members of the hornbill family.
 
• It occurs in the Indian subcontinent and Southeast Asia.
 
• It has been listed as Vulnerable on the **IUCN Red List since 2018.**
 
 
 
• **Indian Roller**
 
 
• The Indian roller is the** state bird of** **Odisha, Telangana, and Karnataka.**
 
• It occurs widely from West Asia to the Indian subcontinent. 
 
• It is listed as a species of least concern on the **IUCN Red List.**
